title: How to deliver the S4 sequence (changes 1-3)
context: Change 1 (GitHub Issues tracker profile) is complete and green. Changes 2 (public-directory readiness) and 3 (S1-S3 hardening) are queued. The working tree is currently uncommitted. Need the owner's call on commit/PR for the sequence.

options.label: Leave all in the working tree; I review and commit myself
Commit each change separately on a feature branch, no PR

rationale: Owner chose one feature branch and a single PR for all three S4 changes
